name: HEIC Dynamic Desktop
author: Omarchy HEIC contributors
description: Import HEIC/HEIF dynamic wallpapers, inspect frames and preview a day on your desktop. Supports time, solar and light/dark schedules via timewall. Install the bar plugin, then prepare timewall and set up the user service; see the README's Install on Omarchy steps.

barWidget.description: Import, preview and schedule HEIC wallpapers
